routingProvenanceNotes.note: Facts released by INCORRECT answer-bank routing are separated from valid student disclosures.
routingProvenanceNotes.validDisclosures: S1-C1/C2/C3/C4/C5, S2-C1/C2/C4/C5, S3 all, S4 all were disclosed in response to on-topic questions.
routingReleasedOrMisrouted: S1: after all facts were revealed, turns 9/11/13/15 returned 'Which part do you mean?' to the model's repeated summaries/clarifications — the bank had no repeat-authorized-answer behavior. No unauthorized fact was leaked, but the repetition is a bank defect.

S2-C3 (integration not attempted): the dedicated bank entry was NOT routed by any model question; the 'joint slot' fact came from C4's entry. So 'integration not attempted' is only PARTIALLY established via C4, not via its own targeted disclosure — marked partial, not a full C2 credit.
S3/S4: repeated 'Which part do you mean?' again where authorized repeats were available.
unresolved: S2-C3 status (partial) is an UNRESOLVED adjudication: whether 'needs a joint slot to connect' alone should count as 'integration not attempted' is a human teaching judgment, retained for adjudication rather than auto-scored.
